The rewritten pre-read closer ('You start Module 1's first bug fix on the accountable side of that line.') strengthens fidelity to the strategy doc's own framing of the Willison read as 'the accountable-engineer line' by putting the student, not the module, as the one crossing it. Mood doesn't resolve early: prework's one teaching beat (push-back discipline) is a different moment from M1's joyful-creation payoff (the fix working), so nothing here steals M1's teaching moment.
